subject.title: fix(openai): bound image generation SSE body reads with idle timeout

question: Should `readChunkWithIdleTimeout` become a supported `media-runtime` plugin SDK export for extension consumers?
rationale: The OpenAI plugin needs a public boundary to reuse core behavior, but adding this low-level helper makes it part of the shipped plugin compatibility surface and repository policy requires explicit API direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow export
options.body: Keep the additive SDK export after fixing the timeout contract and adding compatibility and real-behavior proof.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Use or introduce a higher-level approved media response reader instead of exposing the low-level chunk primitive.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow export
recommendation.body: Keep the additive SDK export after fixing the timeout contract and adding compatibility and real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the affected OpenAI image-generation provider and its behavioral contracts.
